lines.speaker: harrow
lines.text: Keep your voice down, friend, and welcome to what's left of Oakhaven.

lines.speaker: harrow
lines.text: Gate's shut after dusk. Keep it low.

lines.speaker: harrow
lines.text: You shout like that again and I'll put you out through the thorn myself.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: You came. Sit, keep your voice in your chest. I've a thing to ask that I should not ask anyone.
lines.when: !(flags.lyra_wg_met || flags.lyra_dw_met)   // from voices.js lyraState(): after Whisper-Grove she is silent until flags.lyra_voice, then speaks as lyra_ruined

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Come in, close the door. The lamp's lit; we can talk.
lines.when: !(flags.lyra_wg_met || flags.lyra_dw_met)   // from voices.js lyraState(): after Whisper-Grove she is silent until flags.lyra_voice, then speaks as lyra_ruined

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Lower. Please. There are things in this town that learn from every sound.
lines.when: !(flags.lyra_wg_met || flags.lyra_dw_met)   // from voices.js lyraState(): after Whisper-Grove she is silent until flags.lyra_voice, then speaks as lyra_ruined

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Mind the bed, twenty paces off the door. No sound carries over it for a day. Say what you came to say.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: The hounds let you past. That means you came quietly. Good.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: I don't build things anymore. I just know how they break. What do you want broken?

lines.speaker: hetty
lines.text: Sit anywhere that isn't broken. Small beer or smaller. We do not sing in here, not since Davin.

lines.speaker: hetty
lines.text: Beer's a copper. Rooms are a sovereign. Singing is free and it will get you killed.

lines.speaker: hetty
lines.text: I've put bigger men than you out of here for raising their voice. Sit.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Every sailor dies, friend. The trick is to be somewhere else when it happens. Sit; I'm buying, because I'm frightened.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Corsair, Rust Coast, retired from the sea on account of the sea. What'll you have?

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Ha! You have the look of somebody about to tell me something I already know and have been drinking not to hear.

lines.speaker: rooke
lines.text: I have cut more limbs than any butcher in the Reach and done every one with care. Sit. I will not chalk your door today.

lines.speaker: rooke
lines.text: The sap-mark means past cutting. Now it also means the Inquisitor's list. Keep that to yourself.

lines.speaker: rooke
lines.text: Lower your voice in my surgery or I will lower it for you with a needle.

lines.speaker: orla
lines.text: Come closer, I cannot turn. Are you here about Davin?

lines.speaker: orla
lines.text: Mind the roots on the floor. They are mine.

lines.speaker: orla
lines.text: I am a tree with a tongue; shout at me if you like, I cannot leave.

lines.speaker: pim
lines.text: Shh. Mam says I'm not to talk to anybody about my hands.

lines.speaker: pim
lines.text: I'm not supposed to be out. Don't tell.

lines.speaker: vosk
lines.text: Pitch has a colour, through these lenses. Yours is an unremarkable brown. State your business.

lines.speaker: vosk
lines.text: The Consortium pays this town's bread. Remember that before you speak.

lines.speaker: vosk
lines.text: I have Legionnaires. You have a voice. One of those is replaceable.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: The seal of Queen Maelis bids you welcome. Her signature on the decrees is famously steady for a woman dead a hundred and forty years.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: Yes? Be brief. I have the Factor at one shoulder and the Church at the other.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: You sold them, my son says. I fed them, I say. Which of us do you think is lying?

lines.speaker: tobiah
lines.text: Night shift. Keep it under the pumps and the bells won't turn. Are you — are you with him? With Engineer Vance?

lines.speaker: tobiah
lines.text: Nobody comes down here who isn't on the roster. Which you aren't.

lines.speaker: tobiah
lines.text: Quiet! The Legionnaire in Depot Three walks when it hears boots.

lines.speaker: bettany
lines.text: Softly, love. What ails? I have tonic, I have honey for the throat, and I have shot, which I do not approve of and sell anyway.

lines.speaker: bettany
lines.text: Tonic's five. Honey's four. Shot's three the three. Keep your voice down while you count.

lines.speaker: bettany
lines.text: I hummed half this town into the world. I will not be barked at in my own stall.

lines.speaker: tam
lines.text: Sit if you like. She comes on the water about this time. You will hear her if you keep still.

lines.speaker: tam
lines.text: Hm. You are standing where I listen.

lines.speaker: tam
lines.text: Lower your voice. She will not come if you shout.

lines.speaker: hob
lines.text: Evening. Mind the vats; the lime does not care who you are.

lines.speaker: hob
lines.text: Tannery's shut. Nobody wants leather off a town that is turning to wood.

lines.speaker: hob
lines.text: I have buried two apprentices this year. Try me.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: He is not to be looked at. Whoever you are. He has a cough.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: The mill is shut. Say what you want through the door next time.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: Get out of my mill.

lines.speaker: ignatius
lines.text: The Note is held. You may speak under it. Quietly, and in tune.

lines.speaker: ignatius
lines.text: This chapel had bells once. The Synod took them for bore-teeth, and it was right to. A bell is a voice with nobody inside it.

lines.speaker: ignatius
lines.text: I have burned men for less than that tone. I am tired, and the Note is long, and you will not try me again.

lines.speaker: townsman
lines.text: Evening. Keep it low.

lines.speaker: townsman
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: townsman
lines.text: Lower your voice before something hears you.

lines.speaker: townswoman
lines.text: Blessings of the Narrow on you. Softly, now.

lines.speaker: townswoman
lines.text: Yes? Quietly.

lines.speaker: townswoman
lines.text: Hush! The children.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Entry: a stranger, polite, at the wrong end of the continent. Sit. Not there. That is where the proctors will come from.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: I am a list, not a cure. Say what you came to say.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Precision, please. I record everything, including the tone.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Mind the ladder; the third rung is a liar. She'll hold at the mast-height as long as the tanks do, and the tanks are not what they were.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: OK-114, under two coats of paint. She's initialled it eleven times, your scribe. I can tell by the way she looks at my hull.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Say it quick. I don't like a city that doesn't fall down.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Listen. Under the water. Seven forty-one, very faint. The presses.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: This is a dead city that never fell down. That is a statistical anomaly. I do not like anomalies.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: My arm locks when that note is struck near it. Keep me away from the grey men, or keep them away from me.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Entry: the stranger is polite in a drowned city. Noted.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: I am a list, not a cure.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Precision, please. I record everything, including the tone.

lines.speaker: halder
lines.text: Four plates. The blue one is Ada's.

lines.speaker: halder
lines.text: The boys will be in directly.
segments: the boys will be in directly

lines.speaker: halder
lines.text: Sit, sit, there's four.

lines.speaker: quist
lines.text: Hot water? There is always hot water. Sit; the chair is clean. People hesitate less when the chair is clean.

lines.speaker: quist
lines.text: You are not on my list, which means you are on someone else's. Sit down.

lines.speaker: quist
lines.text: Lower your voice. There are people being registered in the next room, and it upsets them.

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.text: DEFEND THE SINGERS.

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.text: DEFEND THE SINGERS.

lines.speaker: lamplighter
lines.text: The lamps are late tonight.

lines.speaker: lamplighter
lines.text: The lamps are late tonight.

lines.speaker: lamplighter
lines.text: The lamps are late tonight.

lines.speaker: bettis
lines.text: Name, please.

lines.speaker: bettis
lines.text: Name, please.

lines.speaker: bettis
lines.text: Name, please.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Ten heartbeats. I counted. This time I didn't cut.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: She's on her side in the willows with a hole in her number-two tank you could post a sheep through. We are not leaving by air today.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Don't. I know. I put a tree through an Office cutter. It seemed like the thing to do.

lines.speaker: tobiah
lines.text: Don't touch that. Or that. That one you can touch, it's already broken.

lines.speaker: tobiah
lines.text: Number-two tank. Look at it. I could weep. I nearly have.

lines.speaker: tobiah
lines.text: I'm an engine man in a forest. Say something useful or hold this.

lines.speaker: mags
lines.text: Slower. I read lips, not minds.
lines.delivery: flat, dry; the first word is an instruction, the second sentence a dry aside

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Seven forty-one is gone. I can hear the woods instead. They are very loud.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Not now.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Entry: the Deep Woods. One wreck, eleven souls, a press, and me.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Two things left in the inventory, and the third does not feel like a gap. It feels like a shelf.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: I am counting. Wait.

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.text: DEFEND THE SINGERS.

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.text: DEFEND THE SINGERS.

lines.speaker: sexton
lines.text: One more before the light goes. One more.
segments: one more before the light goes

lines.speaker: sexton
lines.text: Deep enough. Not deep enough. One more.

lines.speaker: mourner
lines.text: Lilies for the Cantor. Lilies.

lines.speaker: mourner
lines.text: We're late. The bell hasn't gone.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Hello.
lines.delivery: very loud, a child who forgets to be quiet

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Hello.
lines.delivery: very loud, a child who forgets to be quiet

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: weaver
lines.text: {name}, come in now, the water's warm.
segments: come in now, the water's warm
lines.delivery: warm, coaxing, trailing; {name} is the player's FIRST name only (p.name.split(' ')[0]), said twice in the game text ("{name}... {name}, come in now"); function takes the player

lines.speaker: weaver
lines.text: The blue one is Ada's. The boys will be in directly.
segments: the boys will be in directly

lines.speaker: weaver
lines.delivery: sung: the calling-song, beautifully, in Lyra's voice, the voice she does not have any more; no words in the game text

lines.speaker: weaver
lines.text: I am a list, not a cure.
segments: I am a list, not a cure,
lines.delivery: soft, flat; followed by laughter in eleven children's voices (nonverbal, mix separately)

lines.speaker: weaver
lines.text: Hymn nine, page forty. All rise. All rise.
lines.delivery: two hundred voices, all slightly out of time, trailing

lines.speaker: weaver
lines.text: Seven forty-one. I wrote it down myself.

lines.speaker: wearer
lines.text: Lark. Lark, come in now, the house is warm.
segments: Lark, come in now, the house is warm.
lines.delivery: warm, fatherly; the first "Lark" is a call, the rest follows

lines.speaker: wearer
lines.text: Line ninety-four. I initialled it. I was sure for three seconds.
segments: I initialled it. I was sure for three seconds.

lines.speaker: wearer
lines.delivery: sung: the funeral office of Tobin Ashgrove in Tobin Ashgrove's voice, beautifully, a third above Lyra; no words in the game text

lines.speaker: wearer
lines.text: I can't read, lark. I only know what was said out loud.
segments: I only know what was said out loud.
lines.delivery: gently; the text names no mimicked voice, only that it speaks gently and says "lark"

lines.speaker: requiem
lines.delivery: sung: a funeral office for Marta Hale in a hundred voices, all mourners; no lyric in the game text

lines.speaker: requiem
lines.text: Earth to earth, note to note.
segments: Earth to earth, note to note,
lines.delivery: sung, a Cantor three hundred years dead, solemn

lines.speaker: requiem
lines.delivery: sung: the calling-song in Lyra's own voice as she had it at twelve; no words in the game text

lines.speaker: requiem
lines.text: He was a good man, he was a good man, he was a good man.
segments: he was a good man, he was a good man, he was a good man
lines.delivery: murmured litany, every voice that ever said it here, trailing

lines.speaker: wearer
lines.text: {name}.
lines.delivery: warm, exact, the way it used to say it when you were in trouble; {name} = the player's full name (G.player.name)
lines.when: trigger hedge_voice; voice is flags.bio_brother ? your brother : flags.bio_coast ? a first mate you once left in the water : someone you buried

lines.speaker: wearer
lines.text: There's a way through. I can show you. Just say you're there.
segments: There's a way through. I can show you. Just say you're there.
lines.when: trigger hedge_voice (same kin voice as wearer.hedge.0)

lines.speaker: wearer
lines.text: I'm here.
lines.delivery: warm laugh, then the words in the player's own voice; recorded as a generic voice, cannot clone the player

lines.speaker: wearer
lines.text: Grab the line.

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.text: DEFEND. THE. SINGERS.
lines.delivery: slow, three separate struck syllables-words, bronze chord under it

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.text: DEFEND THE SINGERS.
lines.delivery: loud bronze chord-voice; stencilled on its chest, awake hostile

lines.speaker: aegis
lines.text: Forty-one thousand and five.
lines.delivery: a boy's voice from inside the bronze, small, saying a number; said three times in the game text (repeat x3 with a pause)

lines.speaker: core_voice
lines.text: {name}.
lines.delivery: a small voice from inside the cracked bell or core; said three times in the game text; each enemy carries a name (e.name) from NAMES_POOL or its map placement
lines.when: enemy def.core && e.name; applies to legionnaire, proctor, marine, bosun, outrider, captain (and hushwarden)

lines.speaker: deacon
lines.text: SHE IS GIVEN. THE QUIET IS MERCIFUL. GO.
segments: SHE IS GIVEN. THE QUIET IS MERCIFUL. GO.
lines.delivery: SIGNED in hand-cant in the game (his mouth is bound with linen). If voiced at all: a low murmur through linen. Safe to omit.
lines.when: flags.mags_cant (shown only if the player can read hand-cant)

lines.speaker: deacon
lines.text: WHO TAUGHT YOU.
lines.delivery: SIGNED in hand-cant in the game (his mouth is bound with linen). If voiced at all: a low murmur through linen. Safe to omit.
lines.when: after the player signs "The Hush is quiet. It is not merciful." (wildsPeace)

lines.speaker: deacon
lines.text: THEN SHE IS YOURS TO KEEP LOUD,
segments: THEN SHE IS YOURS TO KEEP LOUD,
lines.delivery: SIGNED in hand-cant in the game (his mouth is bound with linen). If voiced at all: a low murmur through linen. Safe to omit.
lines.when: after the player signs "A woman who stopped hearing." (wildsPeace)

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: About time. I go where it's loudest and break what's about to break. You keep us in the Narrow.
lines.delivery: dry; the first words a wry greeting; a faint glass ring may sit under them
segments: I go where it's loudest and break what's about to break. You keep us in the Narrow.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Hear that? The tombs are holding a chord under the floor. Something in here is about to break, and it isn't the stone.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Old bronze. Cracked at the lip, on the east side. Ring it hard and it'll go the rest of the way.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Quiet. Glass won't ring inside one. Iron, and keep moving.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: A funeral office with nobody in it. My arm hates it.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Marble. Hit it where it's already cracked: the elbows.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Office. They hear better than they fight. Kill the horn first.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Static on legs. Cut the threads, not the spider.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: That one's full. I can hear them in her, waiting to hatch.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: They're not making a sound. Not breathing, not footfalls. That takes practice.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Crossbows. Close the distance, or get a willow between you and them.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Felted bell. Don't let it touch you before you've sung what you need.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Hounds. They won't touch the glass. Stay near me.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: You're bleeding into the moss. Back off and let me take it.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Wake me if the arm starts ringing. You'll hear it before I do.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: I'm fine. The arm's ringing, that's all. Give me a minute.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: I don't build things anymore. I just know how they break.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Every willow here has a split about a hand above the root. Damp gets in. Give it ten years.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: The glass is louder out here. Like standing next to a bore that's still turning.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: My father sold the Root to keep the town fed. I keep trying to hate him for it. I keep doing the arithmetic instead.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Lyra taught me the Root note when we were nine. I still hum it when the arm's bad. Don't tell her.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Hounds won't come near the glass. Neither will most people. It's restful.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: There. That's what it sounds like when something stops.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Structural failure. Finally.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Next.
lines.delivery: flat; follows the narration that he flexes the glass hand until it stops ringing

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Not yet. Rest first. Then ask me again.
lines.when: flags.part4 && G.party.downed.kaelen (camp, after he went down)
segments: Rest first. Then ask me again.

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Suits me.
lines.source: party.js camp dialogue ("Stay by the fire.")

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Quiets. Iron, not glass. Get between them and her.
lines.when: Kaelen is the active companion, order != wait, same map; hush-gift event

lines.speaker: kaelen
lines.text: Five of them. I can hear the sickles. Say the word.
lines.when: Kaelen is the active companion, order != wait, same map; Deacon event

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: I'll hum. Under the breath, the way the night-hummers do at the crossings. The Hush won't get near you while I'm humming. I can't do anything about the hounds.
segments: Under the breath, the way the night-hummers do at the crossings. The Hush won't get near you while I'm humming. I can't do anything about the hounds.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: The Cantors of Memory. I learned their names when I was small. I never thought I'd walk on them.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Nobody has rung for the dead out here in three years. You can hear it in the woods. They're waiting.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: That's the office for the dead, sung wrong. Every third line missing. It makes my teeth ache.
lines.delivery: low, warm; her own ruined voice

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: I can't sing near it. Nothing can. Don't let it get between us.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: They cut out their own tongues to be holy. I taught children whose parents did that.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: They're wearing voices. Little ones. Don't listen too closely.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Hounds. Stay low. I'll keep us in the Narrow.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: It's listening for me. It has been listening for me since Oakhaven.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Chord-Wardens. They guard the Cantors. Nobody told them there's no one left to guard.
lines.delivery: low, warm; her own ruined voice

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Grey coats. Keep me behind you.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Hold still. I've got you.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: I'll take first watch. I'll hum. Sleep.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: I'm not built for this. I'm a teacher.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: My father used to say a martyr is just a musician who gave up before the coda.
lines.delivery: low, warm; her own ruined voice

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Feet on the moss, not the twigs. Breathe through your nose. There. That's the Narrow. You're good at it.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: I remember the name of everyone I have sung into the ground. It's the only thing I'm vain about.
lines.delivery: low, warm; her own ruined voice

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Kaelen hums when the arm is bad. He thinks I don't know. I'm the one who taught him that note.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: The reed orchards used to sing in a west wind. Whole hillsides of them. You would have liked it.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Don't thank me for the healing. Thank me when we're all home.
lines.delivery: low, warm; her own ruined voice

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Rest now. Whoever you were.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: It's over. Breathe. It's over.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Not yet. Let me sit a while. Rest, and ask me again.
segments: Let me sit a while. Rest, and ask me again.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: I'll keep it warm.
lines.source: party.js camp dialogue ("Stay by the fire.")

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Put out that lamp. Quiets go to the light. Put it out.
lines.delivery: urgent, low, a sound she has never made before it
lines.when: flags.lyra_voice && Lyra is the active companion, order != wait, same map; hush-gift event
segments: Quiets go to the light. Put it out.

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: He thinks he is being kind. That is the worst of it.
lines.when: flags.lyra_voice && Lyra is the active companion, order != wait, same map; Deacon event

lines.speaker: lyra_ruined
lines.text: Tell him the Cantor says we heard the question too.
lines.delivery: steady, her own ruined voice, formal

lines.delivery: flat Office dialect, boarding crew, hauling

lines.text: That will not be remembered.

lines.text: Round incomplete. Close the book.

harrow.name: Old Harrow, gate-warden
harrow.who: Old gate-warden of Oakhaven; dry, gruff, low-voiced; shuts the gate after dusk and puts shouters out through the thorn.

lyra.name: Lyra Ashgrove, Cantor of Oakhaven
lyra.who: Cantor of Oakhaven, Tobin Ashgrove's daughter; a trained, clear, warm voice with a fierce moral spine; voiced only before Whisper-Grove.

lyra_ruined.name: Lyra Ashgrove, her own ruined voice
lyra_ruined.who: Lyra after she lost her voice; speaks again only once Kaelen has told her everything (flags.lyra_voice): low, breath-heavy and cracked, a Cantor's diction and warmth still under it.

kaelen.name: Kaelen Vance, the Dissonant Blade
kaelen.who: Governor's son and former Chief Resonant Engineer for the Synod; glass left arm from the Foundry; lives outside the Hedge; weary, understated, low gravel, dry; wants to carry all of it alone.

hetty.name: Hetty Bram of the Boar & Dulcimer
hetty.who: Landlady of Oakhaven's tavern; brisk, dry, hard-eyed; has put out bigger men than you; no singing in her house since Davin.

vane.name: Captain Vane of the Drift-Kestrel
vane.who: Corsair captain of the airship Drift-Kestrel, retired from the sea on account of the sea; gallows humour and bravado over old grief (in 414 he held the axe ten heartbeats before he cut the hawser, forty-eight men); mid-age, big voice, often tired.

rooke.name: Surgeon-Grafter Anselm Rooke
rooke.who: Surgeon who has cut more limbs than any butcher in the Reach and done every one with care; clipped, precise, clinical, grim; knows the sap-mark and the Inquisitor's list.

orla.name: Orla Hale
orla.who: A woman turning to wood, rooted to her floor; gentle, dry and wry; asks about Davin.

pim.name: Pim Carder
pim.who: A small boy with something wrong with his hands; whispers; told by his Mam not to talk about it.

vosk.name: Factor Adela Vosk, Consortium of Bores
vosk.who: Consortium factor in lenses that show pitch as colour; cool, precise, mercantile; keeps Legionnaires, counts voices as replaceable.

aldric.name: Governor Aldric Vance
aldric.who: Governor of Oakhaven and Kaelen's father; harried, ironic, an older official pressed between the Factor and the Church; sold the Root to feed the town.

tobiah.name: Tobiah Marsh, engineer
tobiah.who: Junior Engineer on the Oakhaven night shift, later second engineer of the Drift-Kestrel; anxious, fussy, dry despair about engines; younger man's voice.

bettany.name: Bettany, midwife and tonic-maker
bettany.who: Oakhaven midwife and tonic seller; warm, motherly, brisk, prices in coppers; has hummed half the town into the world.

tam.name: Old Tam, the night-hummer
tam.who: Old night-hummer who listens at the water for a singer who comes at night; slow, quiet, murmuring.

hob.name: Hob Wendle, tanner
hob.who: Tanner whose trade has died; gruff, heavy, grieving; has buried two apprentices this year.

nell.name: Nell Carder
nell.who: Keeper of a shut mill, very likely Pim's Mam (shared surname); guarded, protective, sharp; has a sick man in the house with a cough.

ignatius.name: Ignatius Crane, Flambeau of the Pure Note
ignatius.who: Flambeau of the Choir-Church; tired, severe, formal, a man of long calm who has burned men for less.

townsman.name: Oakhaven orchardman
townsman.who: Ordinary Oakhaven orchardman; short, wary, murmuring.

townswoman.name: Oakhaven goodwife
townswoman.who: Ordinary Oakhaven goodwife; devout, hushing, protective of the children.

sable.name: Sable, Archivist of the Veil
sable.who: Archivist of the Silent Veil who keeps the Bound Ledger; soft, rhythmic, haunted, exact; speaks in "Entry:" form.

halder.name: Halder Wick
halder.who: A Hollow in drowned Whisper-Grove, repeating the loop of laying a table for a family; breathy fragments.

quist.name: Registrar-General Quist
quist.who: Registrar-General of the Office in the drowned city; mild, courteous, bureaucratic menace (hot water, clean chair); Mallow is on loan from the Arbiterium, he says.

aegis.name: The Aegis Sentinel
aegis.who: Nine feet of Catalogue bronze and bell-bronze with DEFEND THE SINGERS stencilled on the chest; speaks in slow capitals over a chord; a boy of the Cloister choir, WG-41,005, is inside it.

lamplighter.name: The lamplighter
lamplighter.who: A Hollow with a one-line loop; breathy, trailing.

bettis.name: A Hollow on the bench (Bettis Renn)
bettis.who: A Hollow on a bench asking for a name; breathy, trailing.

mags.name: Mags Tennant, first mate
mags.who: First mate of the Kestrel; lost her hearing, reads lips, signs hand-cant; blunt, dry; arm in a sling in the Deep Woods.

sexton.name: Amos Fell, the Hollow sexton
sexton.who: A Hollow gravedigger in the Spectral Woods, digging the same grave over and over; old, low, trailing.

mourner.name: A Hollow mourner
mourner.who: A Hollow woman with lilies, always late for a funeral; breathy, trailing.

wren.name: Wren
wren.who: A girl of about eight, left singing in a ring of hush-lamps by the Quiet Faith; sings too loudly, whispers when she remembers.

weaver.name: The Phantom Weaver
weaver.who: A named horror of the Cacophony that weaves forgotten voices into a shroud; speaks in whoever it ate (see voiceOf).

wearer.name: The Wearer
wearer.who: The Cacophony that wears Tobin Ashgrove and has practised the player's voice and everyone's; speaks in borrowed voices, warm and exact.

requiem.name: The Requiem
requiem.who: A Cacophony of three hundred years of funeral offices from the Mausoleum of Chords; a mourning veil, a broken bell for a head; sings in the dead's voices.

core_voice.name: The voice in the core
core_voice.who: The small human voice inside a cracked Office or Carillon core when the bell goes still: a named victim, saying their own name three times.

deacon.name: The Deacon of the Unrung Bell
deacon.who: Leader of the Quiet Faith brothers, tall, carries a clapperless bell; his mouth is bound in linen and he signs; kind, sure, low and devout. (Proposed barks voice him murmuring through linen; the game shows him signing.)

captain.name: Outrider-Captain Hal Brennick
captain.who: Officer of the Arbiter's column sent to find out why OC-742 stopped reporting; carries a lit hush-lantern and a sabre; Office dialect, unhurried, courteous, a competent man.

pressman.name: Pressman Mallow
pressman.who: Office of the Catalogue, Second Pressings, on loan from the Arbiterium; a hand-press on his back, a round-book on a chain; big, slow, flat, a clerk of forgetting.

proctor.name: Catalogue Proctor
proctor.who: Grey-oilcloth officer of the Office with a hand-press tuned to 741; flat Office dialect; never uses a verb with a person as its object.

legionnaire.name: Carillon Legionnaire
legionnaire.who: Soldier in a bell-shaped helm with a person's name murmuring inside; bell-throated, few words, liturgical cadence.

marine.name: Cutter-Man
marine.who: Office boarding crew in grey oilcloth with a grapnel line; reels people in; flat Office dialect, treats people as consignment.

bosun.name: Bosun Teller
bosun.who: Bosun of the Office cutter OC-742; keeps the hold key and the count of 432; very polite, exact (he counted crates on and off at Oakhaven for two years).

outrider.name: Office Outrider
outrider.who: Crossbowman of the Arbiter's column in grey oilskin; prefers forty feet to four; calm, distant, reporting.

tobin.name: Tobin Ashgrove
tobin.who: Cantor of Oakhaven, Lyra's father (taken in 417); warm, fatherly baritone; called her "lark".

lyra_child.name: Lyra at twelve
lyra_child.who: Lyra's voice as a girl of twelve, singing the calling-song.

cantor_old.name: A Cantor three hundred years dead
cantor_old.who: An old Cantor of Memory from the Mausoleum of Chords; solemn, ancient, sung.

chorus_mourners.name: A chorus of mourners
chorus_mourners.who: A hundred voices, all mourners, from the funeral offices of the Mausoleum.

chorus_congregation.name: The Cloister congregation
chorus_congregation.who: Two hundred voices singing Hymn 9 slightly out of time (the Cloister of the Lost Choir).

player_mother.name: The player's mother (as the Weaver wears her)
player_mother.who: The player's mother, a warm calling voice; generic woman's voice in recording since it cannot be tailored.

player_kin.name: Someone the player knew (brother, first mate, or the buried)
player_kin.who: The hedge voice: the player's brother, a first mate they left in the water, or someone they buried, by player background. Record neutral and warm.

player.name: The player
player.who: The player's own voice as the Wearer plays it back; generic mid voice; cannot be cloned.

wg41005.name: WG-41,005, a boy of the Cloister choir
wg41005.who: The boy inside the Aegis; small, plain, saying his intake number.
